description: Displays a hierarchical tree view of files and directories across multiple Azure DevOps repositories within a project, based on their default branches

depth.description: Maximum depth to traverse within each repository (0 = unlimited)

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the Azure DevOps organization (Default: unknown-organization)

pattern.description: File pattern (wildcard characters allowed) to filter files by within each repository

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

repositoryPattern.description: Repository name pattern (wildcard characters allowed) to filter which repositories are included

name: get_all_repositories_tree
